title: Email templates
subtitle: Notification templates rendered for email and in-app messages.

editor.readOnly: You can view this template but not change it.
editor.name: Name
editor.isActiveHint: Inactive templates aren't used for new notifications.
editor.subject: Subject template
editor.bodyHint: Plain text; also used for in-app messages.
editor.bodyHtmlHint: Optional. Email clients that show HTML use this instead of the plain body.
editor.sampleDataHint: JSON object of template variables, used for the preview.
editor.invalidJson: Sample data must be valid JSON.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Rendered from the form as it is now, with the sample data.
preview.subject: Subject

delete.title: Delete template?
delete.body: {{name}} will be removed. Past notifications that used it are kept.

leave.title: Discard unsaved changes?
leave.body: Your edits to this template haven't been saved.

history.title: History of {{name}}
history.subtitle: Every saved version, newest first. Open one to see what changed or to restore it.
history.comparePreviousHint: What this version changed from version {{version}}.
history.firstVersionHint: The first recorded version, in full.
history.compareCurrentHint: What restoring this version would change.
history.isCurrent: The template already matches this version.
history.restoreBody: {{name}} will be put back as it was at version {{version}}: its code, name, description, subject, bodies, sample data, and active setting. The current content stays in the history, so this can be undone.
